prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: exactly one independent horizontal full-bleed card portrait illustration; not a card frame, UI panel, atlas, spritesheet, Spine attachment, or pose sheet.

Consumer contract:
The generated 3:2 source will later receive the largest deterministic centered crop to 25:19 and a Lanczos resize to 1000x760. Keep Vivhite's face, both hands, the projection plane, its readable geometric construction, and the beam's decisive launch within the central approximately 82% of the source width. Render an edge-to-edge richly painted rectangular card illustration with meaningful color, atmosphere, and motion continuing naturally to all four edges; do not leave decorative margins or a vignette border.

Input images and strictly separated roles:
Image 1 defines Vivhite's identity, magical-girl costume family, rendering language, and overall visual style. It does not define this card's pose or composition.
Image 2 defines the original costume structure, blue butterfly ornament, silver-white / indigo / violet palette, and ornamental color relationships. It does not define her face or this card's pose.
Image 3 defines only the face identity: short silver-white hair, violet eyes, round gold glasses, and a cool, restrained, cute expression. It does not define costume structure or pose.

Primary request:
Illustrate exactly one Vivhite in a dynamic three-quarter close view performing a clearly readable empty-handed magical attack toward screen-right. She compresses a taut silver-white and blue-violet string of light between her bare hands and launches it from a geometric projection plane as a long, narrow beam toward the right edge. The instant must read immediately at small card size as a linear magical shot: concentrated hand force at the origin, a crisp acceleration point, and strong directional speed.

Projection geometry:
Show one coherent foreshortened luminous projection plane near her hands. Use a small, clearly countable family of parallel construction lines, one clean perpendicular descent meeting the plane, corresponding projected points, and a thin elongated light ray. Express mathematics only through pure geometry and spatial alignment. The geometric structure must remain visually legible instead of dissolving into generic sparkles, and it must contain no readable symbols.

Character and action:
Preserve Vivhite's silver-white short hair, violet eyes, round gold glasses, ornate cute magical-girl costume, blue butterfly ornament, and cool focused temperament from the assigned references. Her glasses sit correctly on the face; both hands have natural anatomy and readable fingers. Her hands are completely empty and visibly shaping magic, never gripping an object. Hair, ribbons, sleeves, and particles follow the rightward acceleration while her face remains identifiable.

Life-cost cue:
Place only one tiny, restrained bead of crimson magical light at the corner of her lips, already dissolving into a fine crimson filament that merges with the outgoing beam. It is an elegant magical cost cue, not blood, not a wound, and not horror. Use crimson only as a sparse high-contrast accent against the dominant silver-white, indigo, and violet palette.

Surface and edge treatment:
Use dense opaque pigment and ink across every pixel of the rectangular canvas. Make the scene crisp, solid, richly painted, and fully rendered all the way to each of the four edges and all four corners. Preserve substantial painted color, texture, and scene detail at every edge. No fading, no feathered wash, no translucent veil, no vignette, no pale mist dissolving toward the perimeter, and no soft empty fringe. The result must read as one complete, fully covered rectangular painting rather than a floating cutout or an isolated layer.

Style and finish:
Premium painterly fantasy card illustration with crisp anime-influenced character design, refined fabric and glass highlights, controlled luminous geometry, strong depth, energetic directional brushwork, and decisive edge-to-edge paint coverage. Maintain visual continuity with Image 1 while letting the attack silhouette and projection construction dominate. Full-bleed lighting and magical atmosphere remain richly painted and visually substantial across the entire rectangular canvas.

Constraints:
Exactly one character and one action moment. No sword, blade, staff, wand, rod, gun, bow, book, scroll, shield, tool, prop, held object, or weapon of any kind. No second character, duplicate limbs, extra hands, malformed fingers, obscured eyes, missing glasses, or missing blue butterfly. No readable number, letter, equation, formula, rune, glyph, pseudo-text, caption, card title, UI, logo, signature, or watermark. No card frame or border. No gore, injury, open wound, splatter, horror, or threatening blood imagery. Keep all identity-critical and action-critical elements safe inside the centered 25:19 crop while preserving an edge-to-edge full-bleed painting.
